analysis.description: Opening subject and answer statements only, manually transcribed from the score and checked against Foster's discussion. The rest of the fugue is not represented.

notes: The bass entry is at m. 9 in the AMP score, after the short interlude. Foster identifies the entry order and exposition cadence at m. 12, but gives a less precise description of the interlude; the plotted positions follow the score. Only the opening statements are represented; subsequent inversions, retrogrades and augmentation are outside this excerpt. Manual score transcription of opening subject and answer statements, checked against Dorothy Nell Foster (1973), Chapter IV. Quarter-note units; entry ends include the final note and all its written ties. Excerpts extend through the final subject release when it passes the exposition cadence. No recording timing has been estimated. A short independently engraved subject incipit is included; the source score, thesis prose and chart images are not redistributed.
